svg.title: TOPAK G3 — Theorem to premise: what every checked or proved property rests on, and what is void at the reference
svg.desc: spec/theorem-premise-binding.md (2026.09.30, revised 2026.10.01, 2026.10.02 with ADR-0046, and 2026.10.02 for the launcher, "pending" ADR-0033 A7; DRAFT, revised with the records it binds, and not revised since) is the table ADR-0045 §3 owes and ADR-0023 §2 assumes: one row per checked property, naming the trusted-base rows (ADR-0045 Annex A), the degeneracy parameters (ADR-0023 §6a) and the declared gaps it rests on. A property holds for a deployment when every row it names is declared delegated or trust root, every parameter holds and no gap premise is false; otherwise it is void. 38 of its 43 rows name a proof module, 15 modules in all; at G10 twelve of those certify and three do not, and seven of the twenty-two proof modules have no row: the six G10 names behind the records (§2.6, item 90, open) and Correlator, whose record is Proposed. Where a record moved and the table did not (A7, B29; ADR-0034 A2 and ADR-0042 §6, B30), the verdict is drawn as the table states it and marked. Drawn four ways: the gap, the key chains as a DAG, the full incidence matrix, and the table itself, all 43 rows. spec/theorem-premise-binding.json carries the same table as a Boolean matrix and spec/inventory.py --check fails when the two disagree; this diagram reads the Markdown.

A property holds for a deployment when

every row it names is declared delegated or trust root, every parameter holds and no gap premise is false; otherwise it is void. 38 of its 43 rows name a proof module, 15 modules in all; at G10 twelve of those certify and three do not, and seven of the twenty-two proof modules have no row: the six G10 names behind the records (§2.6, item 90, open) and Correlator, whose record is Proposed. Where a record moved and the table did not (A7, B29; ADR-0034 A2 and ADR-0042 §6,

B30), the verdict is drawn as the table states it and marked. Drawn four ways: the gap, the key chains as a DAG, the full incidence matrix, and the table itself, all 43 rows. spec/theorem-premise-binding.json carries the same table as a Boolean matrix and spec/inventory.py --check fails when the two disagree; this diagram reads the Markdown.
One row per checked property: what it assumed. A property is void for a deployment when a row it names is excluded,
undeclared (ADR-0045 §3 rule 1) or refused, or a parameter or gap premise is false.
The last column computes ADR-0023 §2's inventory for the reference against ADR-0045 Annex B.
Since B25 the Checked in column names the proof module beside the base module (ADR-0046 §5); 38 rows name one.
The file's words: "A proof by itself. Every property here was checked by TLC at small constants, or restated as a test, by the
same hands that wrote the records, and the invariants of thirty-seven rows are also proved" by the proof module the Checked
in column cites, by the same hands.
A row says what a check or a proof assumed; it strengthens neither. Proved is of the module and under named hypotheses
(ADR-0046 §1); neither method claims anything of the running reference (T-0045-28).
T-0045-1 replicas apply the ordered log as crash-fault machines; T-0045-11 the records are the ratified records; T-0045-29
TLC at the constants run; T-0045-30 the build toolchain.
T-0045-28: the running code refines the specification. No refinement exists, so for a running deployment every property is
A row with a proof module (B25): the invariant rests on T-0045-31, the prover, in place of T-0045-29, for every constant the
proof's assumptions admit; the mutations and witnesses rest on T-0045-29 as before.

text.tspan: Status of the table and its records

svg.text: ADR-0045 is Accepted (genesis), confirmation required C2, C4 (Batch 22, R6 added the table). ADR-0046 revised it in place
(Batch 25, 2026.10.02; C2, C4): the proof column and five corrections.
The table itself is a DRAFT, revised with the records it binds; its versioning belongs to the archetype-evolution record, still
unwritten (G10 item 7). Last revised 2026.10.02, "pending" ADR-0033 A7; A7 and ADR-0034 A2 have been ratified since
(B29, B30) and the table was not revised (G10 §2.6, item 90). Never… witnesses are not theorems and are omitted.

text.tspan: 0 · What the table covers at G10, and what it does not: twenty-two proof modules, fifteen bound, twelve of those certified; seven with no row

svg.text: G10 §2.6: "The binding table has no rows for Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency or the two successor modules." Item 90, spec/ behind the records, also names RulesFloorBase.tla. Certification is ADR-0046 A1's (Batch 28): every obligation closed by the prover's normalization, an SMT proof the ethos checker accepted, a Zenon proof Isabelle checked, or an LS4 temporal step no checker confirms (spec/proof-certification.md §2, §9; G10 §2.9). Obligation counts are each module's certified results file.

text.tspan: No row, and its record is Proposed: not named by item 90
Six modules, 1,734 obligations, no premise rows

svg.text: Every property Labels, ToolList, Operators, Emergency, BreakGlass_A1 and NonComposition_A1 prove is outside the inventory: no row names what it rests on, so the last column computes
nothing for it, at the reference or for any deployment.
So T-0045-32 to 36, the five trusted-base rows Batch 34 added for the same records, are premises of no row (the matrix below draws their columns empty).
The record behind each is in force; two are provisional (ADR-0050, ADR-0052), so their properties would bind to text that is subject to redesign (ADR-0029 A4).
The rule space has bgScope : SUBSET BGActs, and Entry reads "R6" -> r.exceptions <= 2 and "R7" -> r.bgScope \cap AuthActs = {}.
ADR-0026 A2 (Batch 34, provisional with ADR-0052): R6's count is one, X1 being retired; R7 is read as "no activation of an emergency seating grants a lease whose alphabet holds an authority act" (G10
Anchor.tla and BreakGlass.tla extend it, so the rows FloorPreserved and BreakGlassNeverChangesAuthority rest on the old rule space. BreakGlass_A1 extends it too and reads bgScope for
nothing (its header). The ADR-0026 §6 rerun is still owed (G10 §2.1).

text.tspan: Two rows proved of modules that model X1, and one on R7 as first written

svg.text: NC1, NC2 (NonComposition.tla) and BreakGlassNeverChangesAuthority (BreakGlass.tla) are proved of predecessors that model X1, which is retired. Their successors, NonComposition_A1 and
BreakGlass_A1, are proved and certified and have no row; the predecessors stay frozen and cited by digest (G10 §3).
P7_BGNoAuthority is R7 as first written; A2 changed R7's subject.
Certified is not verified. It removes the SMT solver's soundness as a premise; the prover's translation, its normalization, LS4 and the checker stay trusted (G10 §3, §8; T-0045-31).
It changes no verdict in the last column: a proof is of the module, not of what runs (T-0045-28). Operators.tla and Emergency.tla are tied to the reference by tests and no refinement (item 90).

text.tspan: Batch 25 (ADR-0046 §4, §5): the proof column, and five corrections the proofs found

svg.text: Each proof module takes as hypothesis only the mutations that break each invariant, written independently of the table; where the two disagreed TLC agreed with the proof, and the table was corrected (G8 §3, result 2). The corrections' TLC rows are spec/premise-corrections-results-2026.10.02.txt (2669499135d2ea42), every outcome as predicted.

text.tspan: Since Batch 36 (ADR-0053 §5, R7): a Lean route beside the proof column, as derived premises

svg.text: Ratified 2026.10.06 in Batch 36: the table carries what follows. Counts are computed from spec/theorem-premise-binding.json at build time against the proof modules spec/lean re-encodes (H7).
32 of 43 rows name only proof modules spec/lean re-encodes: their *Checked in* column gains the Lean file, "proved in Lean in
FloorComposition's rows also gain "the code's decision refines its Decide, in Lean" (mechanism/lean, ADR-0053 R2): its
invariants hold of every behaviour in which the code decides, on T-0045-3 at the module's size.
The floor gates' row gains floor/lean for totality, non-vacuity and discrimination, on the genesis floor and the floor in force.
Two proofs give a disjunction: a property holds if T-0045-31 holds, or if T-0045-37 holds and the encoding is the module. A derived
premise names it: invariant(M), an OR of AND-routes, still monotone, so excluding a premise only voids.
premise-routes-results-2026.10.08b.txt, read at build time: 15 invariant(M), 2 encodings whose faithfulness is a check
on the graph check, and refines(Seats), T-0045-28 or the Lean stage. With T-0045-31 excluded and T-0045-37 trusted, 9 of 43
rows hold, where the binding before the merge said 38 (finding 13: no row named T-0045-31).

floor in force (R3) under cedar-spec's model, they rest on T-0045-37 and T-0045-3's own premise, "the Cedar engine, as faithful
The verdict at the reference is unchanged: T-0045-3 is a trust root either way.
R1's precondition (ADR-0053): (a) the table states alternative sets, since the merge; (b) each refined encoding a named premise
with a check: Seats and FloorComposition have the graph check, eleven do not.
refines(Seats) is a route a deployment may declare, by declaring the Seats-shaped model faithful; no ADR-0033 addendum
cites it as a stage, and confirmation is required for it (ADR-0029 C4).

text.tspan: 2 · The full incidence matrix: 43 rows × 36 trusted-base rows, 16 parameters, 6 gaps, Proposed or stale premises and inputs, with the proof and certification columns

svg.text: Rows in the table's order, grouped by module. A column's chip and every dot in it carry the premise's class at the reference, so a void row shows the red dot that voids it. A large dot is a premise the row names; a ring is one it names only at a declared rung; a small grey dot is a BASE premise; a square is a parameter, gap or input premise. Uncited rows (T-0045-7, T-0045-26) are drawn so their absence shows, and so are T-0045-32 to 36, added at Batch 34 for modules the table has no rows for (item 90). T-0045-31, the

prover, is a BASE premise of the 38 proved rows only, for the invariant; T-0045-29 stays in every row's BASE for the mutations and witnesses. The struck K < R has no column. Chips follow Annex B: T-0045-19 and 20 have a rung-1 instance and 16 and 17 are SIMULATED (B29); T-0045-24 is excluded there although the reason ended with ADR-0033 A9 (item 89). The certification pill reads the proof modules a row names: a row is certified only if every one is.

text.tspan: Reading the last column as an inventory (the file's own words)

svg.text: At the reference, every theorem premised on confinement, gate evidence, hermeticity or channel fidelity is void; the routing theorem and the gate verdicts rest on checked proofs since 2026.10.01, where before they were the solver's assertion; the bundle's
revision is a file name; the reach bound is declared and not enforced.

What remains holds of the modules and, by trace validation, of the running code on every tested path: the lease, the fence, revocation, composition, the rules floor, the bootstrap pair, seats, any-of, coupling with its collusion gap, Run's counters and seal. That is
ADR-0045 Annex B's inventory sentence, computed.

text.tspan: Keeping it current, and where it is stale

svg.text: A new property adds a row; a new T-row or degeneracy adds a premise; an ADR-0033 addendum that changes a row's class at the reference changes the last column. tools/check-refs.py does not read this file.
A premise edge added into an existing theorem weakens it and needs its own record (ADR-0023 carried scope); the archetype-evolution record owns that rule (G10 item 7).

Stale as drawn: the inventory sentence still says "the bundle's revision is a file name" while its own BundleRefusalHonored row says the revision is verified since 2026.10.01, and calls every theorem premised on confinement void while FreshAppraisal now

holds at rung 1; "What this is not" says thirty-seven rows are proved, where 38 name a proof module; the trace row says 57 traces, 642 steps (Mechanism-trace-results-2026.10.02.txt), where G10 §3 records 82 traces, 1,007 steps (
Mechanism-trace-results-2026.10.05.txt, ADR-0033 A14), every step matching and every state keeping ConfinementRefinement.tla's invariants.

Stale against G10 (§2.6, item 90): four confinement rows still say "pending ADR-0033 A7", ratified at B29; the RunConfinement row says "pending: A2 is not ratified" and "ADR-0042 §6 in force (Proposed)", both ratified at B30; no rows for six modules;
RulesFloorBase.tla behind ADR-0026 A2 (section 0). The verdicts above are the table's, marked where a record has moved.
